# T-2: Implement scenario-validity runner

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Run spec-local tests before implementation, classify per-requirement outcomes, and write scenario-validity artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Runner discovers existing spec-local test files only
- Runner writes scenario-validity-result.json and tests/.raw/scenario-validity.log
- Runner blocks on implementation-target changes and invalid outcome classes
- Runner validates per-requirement evidence and raw output line ranges

## Implementation Notes
Prefer existing helpers from test-headers.js, test-artifacts.js, and test-regression.js. Add dedicated classes for outcome records and artifacts rather than object-literal discriminated unions.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for pass, unexpected pass, invalid test, skipped, not-run, missing evidence, and precondition block cases.
